build_layoutlmv3_image_processor: build a LayoutLMv3ImageProcessor instance to preprocess document images with OCR and bounding boxes
run_ocr_on_document_image: run Tesseract OCR on a document image to extract words and normalized bounding boxes
normalize_bounding_box_coordinates: normalize bounding box coordinates to 0-1000 scale relative to image dimensions
preprocess_document_images_with_ocr: preprocess a batch of document images with resizing, normalization, and OCR word extraction
configure_ocr_language_and_config: configure OCR language and Tesseract config flags when initializing the LayoutLMv3ImageProcessor
